shot1: Shot 1 opens without transition, using a wide high-angle slightly level shot. Composition centers on the clearing as a natural stage, with even cold-toned morning light diffused through mist. Clothing and hair tips are subtly outlined by backlight. Camera slowly lowers and gently pushes in, guiding viewers from environment into performance.

shot7: Frame captures summit platform, snow peaks, and sea together.
